Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Whatley
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver
Date: 03/08/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 226 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Human Resources to conduct pre-placement investigations ordered by the court for child custody cases by an estimated $465 per case. Per the Department, for fiscal year 2019, there were 6,700 divorces involving dependent children in Alabama.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary

Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Whatley
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver
Date: 03/16/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 226 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Human Resources to conduct pre-placement investigations ordered by the court for child custody cases by an estimated $465 per case. Per the Department, for fiscal year 2019, there were 6,700 divorces involving dependent children in Alabama.
As amended and reported by the Committee on Judiciary, DHR would be required to conduct home evaluations instead of pre-placement investigations, at a cost of $465 per evaluation.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary
